title: Internal: Understanding Credit Card Referral Statuses.
summary: This document defines credit card referral statuses—COMPLETE, IN_PROGRESS, NO_PROGRESS, APPLIED, REJECTED, and ERROR—and explains what each means and what support agents should do next (grant bonus per terms, monitor, remind, wait, avoid immediate retry, or retry/escalate).
faqs: What does COMPLETE mean in a credit card referral process?
If a referral is IN_PROGRESS, do I need to take any action?
What should I do when the referral status is NO_PROGRESS?
What does APPLIED indicate, and should I intervene manually?
Why would a referral be marked REJECTED and what should I do next?
How should I handle an ERROR referral status?
